See our returns & refunds policy and terms & conditions.

article.p: Runodoo sells online services: Odoo hosting subscriptions and paid support sessions. Because nothing physical is shipped, “returns” and “exchanges” mean cancelling a service or switching to another plan. This policy explains when you get your money back and how to ask for it.

Every new account starts with a free trial (15 days unless the offer says otherwise). No payment card is needed and nothing is charged during the trial. If you do not choose a paid plan, the trial simply ends.
article.h2: 2. Money-back guarantee on your first payment
article.p: If you are not satisfied, you can ask for a full refund of your first subscription payment within 14 days of that payment. Your environments are then stopped and, after 14 more days, deleted. Download your backups before asking for the refund.

ul.li: You can cancel at any time from your account or by contacting us.
The cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Your service keeps running until then and you are not charged again.
Apart from section 2 and section 6, payments for a billing period that has already started are not refunded, in full or in part.
Upgrade (bigger plan): takes effect immediately. You pay only the difference for the rest of the current period.
Downgrade (smaller plan): takes effect at the start of the next billing period, provided your usage fits the smaller plan. The unused difference is not paid back.
Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours before the session: full refund or a free new date, as you prefer.
Less than 24 hours before, or if you do not attend: no refund.
If we cancel the session or cannot deliver it: full refund.

article.p: If you were charged twice, charged the wrong amount, or charged after a cancellation took effect, we refund the extra amount in full. If the service is unavailable because of us for more than 24 hours in a row in a billing period, you may ask for a credit or refund for those days.
article.h2: 7. How to ask for a refund

ol.li: Write to us through the contact page or at .
Include the e-mail of your account, the invoice number and the reason.
We answer within 2 working days and, once approved, issue the refund within 7 working days.

article.p: Refunds go back to the original payment method (card or wallet) through our payment provider. Your bank or wallet may take up to 14 days more to show it. Amounts are refunded in the currency of the payment (Egyptian pounds unless the invoice says otherwise); bank fees and exchange-rate differences are not covered.

These terms apply to www.runodoo.online, app.runodoo.online and every service Runodoo provides (together, the “Service”). By creating an account, starting a trial or paying for the Service you accept them. If you use the Service for a company, you accept them on its behalf.
The Service is operated by Runodoo, based at Block H6, Ibn Melka St, First Settlement, New Cairo 1, Cairo Governorate 11865, Egypt. You can reach us through our contact page.

Runodoo hosts Odoo databases (“environments”) for you: production, staging and test copies, daily backups, monitoring and, optionally, deployment to a server you own. We also sell paid support sessions with Odoo experts. Odoo is a trademark of Odoo S.A.; Runodoo is not affiliated with Odoo S.A.

ul.li: You must be at least 18 and give true, up-to-date information.
Keep your password and two-factor device safe. You are responsible for everything done with your account.
Tell us straight away if you think someone else is using your account.
New accounts get a free trial. When it ends, environments stop unless you choose a paid plan.
Paid plans are billed in advance, monthly or yearly, at the price shown when you order. Prices are in US dollars unless stated otherwise; taxes are added where the law requires.
Payments are processed by our payment provider; we never see or store your full card details.
If a payment fails, we may suspend the Service after notice until it is paid.
We may change prices with at least 30 days' notice; the new price applies from your next billing period.
Cancellations, plan changes and refunds follow our returns & refunds policy.

article.p: You may not use the Service to:

ul.li: break any law, or store or send illegal, harmful or infringing content;
send spam or unsolicited bulk e-mail;
mine cryptocurrency, run attacks, scan other systems or try to break out of your environment;
overload the platform or get around plan limits.

article.p: We may suspend an environment at once when it harms the platform or other customers, and will tell you why.

ul.li: Your databases, files and code remain yours. We use them only to run the Service for you.
You can download a full backup at any time while your account is active.
After a cancellation or the end of a trial, we keep your data for 14 days, then delete it with its backups.
We keep your data confidential and give it to third parties only when needed to run the Service (for example, the payment provider) or when the law requires it.

article.p: We work to keep the Service online around the clock and take daily backups, but we do not promise it will never be interrupted. Planned maintenance is announced in advance where possible. You should keep your own copies of important data.

Custom modules and repositories you connect stay your property and responsibility. You confirm you have the right to use them. Odoo Enterprise modules need your own valid Odoo Enterprise subscription.

To the extent the law allows, Runodoo is not liable for indirect losses such as lost profits, lost revenue or lost data, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 3 months before the claim.
You can close your account at any time. We may suspend or close it if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms or do not pay, after notice where possible.
We may update these terms. We will tell you about important changes by e-mail or in your account at least 15 days before they apply. If you keep using the Service after that, the new terms apply.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Any dispute that cannot be settled amicably goes to the competent courts of Cairo.
